title: Puzzle 2d Disappears On Drop
description: Fix puzzle 2d disappearing when dropping a palette shape.
summary: Fixed puzzle 2d canvas going blank after palette drop: host reconciler teardown no longer emits structural nodeDelete storms; play shell queues filtered deletes and suppresses fixture→canvas delete sync while the graph is mutating; palette seeds merge via meta or palette-seed-* id instead of replacing the whole fixture. Tests: puzzle/2d/react 85/85, play 5/5, framework mergePalette vitest pass.
